description: Na₅CoO₄ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.59 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.40 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.44 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.38 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.37 Å. Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.97 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Co atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-54°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co pentagonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-61°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Co atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Co octahedra.
